not_blind: Exploratory study on data that were already reviewed (PR #55-#64). Not a blind or independent test.

definitions.common_closed: both the baseline and the alternative trade are closed
definitions.net_return_pct: per-trade net return after the engine costs; a trade average, not an account return
definitions.R_common_denominator: net return % / baseline initial risk % at the real fill price (both methods)
definitions.R_own: net return % / own initial risk % at the real fill price
definitions.not_applicable: no alternative stop was applied; the baseline stop is not substituted

R_common_closed.note: R = net return % divided by the initial risk % at the real fill price. Trade averages, not account returns.
